name: Return to the chart from not found

planSteps.description: Take the address of the page already open, keep everything before '#' exactly as it is, and open it with '#/no-such-page' after it (for example .../#/no-such-page). Do not go to any other site address. Wait 3 seconds
Click the link back to the chart
Verify the chart page is displayed
Verify the 'Eye Chart' heading is displayed
